title: Coleman Hawkins as a fishing friend
summary: Hawkins bought five hundred dollars of fishing gear, ran a miniature train set, and drove too fast.

blocks.x: You did another date in 1944 with Coleman Hawkins. Did you know Coleman Hawkins well.

Oh yeah we were good friends. He was one of the fellas that used to go fishin'. He'd go fishin'. Man I took him fishin' one time and the next time I know this cat had about 500 dollars worth of fishin' stuff & he didn't even know which way it go. . . . He had money. He had a hell of a train set. A lot of people didn't know. A train, man, ran a couple rooms it was a real train--miniature, but it was a train set.

Up on Sugar Hill. #157th somewhere up there. But we used to go fishin', but this cat drove too fast. He scared me to death. He had a new cadillac, I mean new, brand new. . . . But he drove too fast. I think we used to go up into the mountains to the lakes or somethin'. We went out on a boat and I get seasick and oh, it was a mess. He caught some fluke. And he got all this. . . . tackle and didn't know what to do with it. . . . He got all this stuff goin' on the fishin' boat like he was gonna catch jaws or somethin'. . . .
